summary: Iteration 5 verifies SEC-001 (encrypted exchange API keys at rest, masked-only in responses), SEC-002 (SSE stream now requires short-lived stream-token; access JWT rejected on /trading/stream) and full regression on auth, IDOR, cloud trading, notifications, aggregated multi-exchange endpoints, and Persian/RTL frontend. Backend: 19/19 tests PASS. Frontend smoke: admin login, notifications bell + panel open, Auto-Trade page renders risk-status-indicator=Active, consecutive-losses-value=0/5, drawdown-value=0.0%/20%, cloud-toggle-button=Enable Cloud Trading, cloud-status-value=Off. Persian toggle switches html[dir]=rtl and html[lang]=fa; drawdown/consecutive-losses numbers keep English digits (0.0%, 20%, 0/5) — no Persian digits leak. DB-level check confirms exchange_connections have api_key_enc (Fernet) + api_key_masked only, no plaintext api_key field. State cleaned via /trading/demo/reset at end of run.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py create_stream_token / decode_stream_sub correctly use type='stream' + 60s expiry, isolated from access JWT (type='access'). decode_stream_sub rejects any non-stream JWT — SEC-002 verified end-to-end.

exchanges.py _fernet reads DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY (separate from JWT_SECRET); _legacy_fernet retained only for backward-compat decrypt of legacy rows. /connect writes api_key_enc + api_key_masked and $unsets legacy api_key on update — correct migration path.
exchanges.py _oid raises HTTPException(404) on any invalid ObjectId — malformed ids (/exchanges/xyz/test, /exchanges/notanid) correctly return 404 not 500.
notifications.py DELETE also guards ObjectId → 404 on bad id. List is scoped by user_id. Good.
trading.py /stream uses decode_stream_sub (not decode_access_sub). Access JWT passed as query param is now rejected with 401. Verified.

trading.py /cloud/enable also sets settings.auto_trade=True so the cron loop actually runs. /cloud/disable inversely. auto_status returns cloud_trading + cloud_status + risk_mode + limits object as spec'd.
One observation (not blocking): decode_access_sub is still defined in auth.py but no route uses it after the SEC-002 fix — safe to remove in a follow-up cleanup.
Frontend AutoTrade.jsx exposes all required data-testids; Persian mode renders LTR digits inside RTL layout (numeric spans appear to force en-US locale) — good UX.
test_credentials: admin@firebird.ai / Firebird#2026 — verified via login + cookie + Bearer.
seed_data_creation: Created a coinex exchange connection on admin (encrypted test keys) and registered one temporary IDOR user. Called /trading/demo/reset at teardown so admin balance is back to $100 with no positions and cloud_trading=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_security_iter5.py -v -o addopts='' (pytest.ini enables xdist). All 5 test files under /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (regression), test_security_iter2.py, test_owner_iter3.py, test_rules_iter4.py, test_security_iter5.py. /api/auth/register aggressively rate-limits at 5/hour/IP — the IDOR fixture uses pytest.skip on 429. Language toggle in header is the 'EN' button (opens dropdown), not a data-testid. Persian option label is 'فارسی'. AutoTrade route is /auto-trade.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — both security fixes verified working. SEC-002: separate stream-token type prevents access-JWT reuse in URL. SEC-001: dedicated DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY-based Fernet with masked-only wire format prevents plaintext exposure in responses and DB.
